Lately it seems that society has lessened its use of the word "evil" except in those stories of superheroic good vs evil. We can often agree that criminals are bad people, but can we say that criminals are evil? Or taking a step away from the individual, is crime itself evil?

No, because we've outgrown thinking only in the false dichotomy of good and evil.

We could label an act as evil, yet, with enough knowledge, we could also excuse the act as being a misfortune of circumstance. One such act that is commonly labeled as evil is theft. However with a greater understanding in social science, we're seeing that theft is often a criminal act in which a thief tries to better their current financial standings. Yes, there are legal ways to go about earning enough to sustain a lifestyle, but these services may not be efficient enough or barriers that could make the illegal act seem the better course of action.

It depends on your definition of evil. Biblically, yes; vernacularly, no.

As you state, the definition of evil has changed, because society has changed. With out greater understanding of psychological, sociological, and criminological motives for crime it is no longer appropriate to define acts as evil.

I highly recommend pifm to any pi user it's easy to load a playlist and then have radio all across your house. The python script is available online and you don't need any new equipment at all, the only downside is that it only uses .wav files
what's pifm? I'm always looking to expand my pi's abilities

It's Raspberry pi radio Pi-Fm. It is a python script that transmits a .way file on any frequency between 80-120 through the gpio pin number 4. If you attach an aerial (or piece of wire) to that pin then you can get a really strong signal for a about a hundred metres +. I'll post a link to the script when I find it.
